title: Món này quá cay đối với tôi.
englishTitle: This is too spicy for me.
pronunciation: Mon nay qua cay doi voi toi
summary: For telling restaurant staff the dish is too spicy for you after tasting it.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Say it calmly after one bite if you need rice, water, a milder replacement, or less chili.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Point to the dish, then ask for less chili, more rice, or another option.

phrases.vietnamese: Món này quá cay đối với tôi.
phrases.english: This is too spicy for me.
phrases.pronunciation: Mon nay qua cay doi voi toi

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Món này means this dish; quá cay means too spicy; đối với tôi means for me.

breakdown.vietnamese: Món này quá cay đối với tôi.
breakdown.english: This is too spicy for me.

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Good after tasting, before the dish is remade, or before another person adds more chili.

phrases.vietnamese: Món này chưa được nấu chín kỹ
phrases.pronunciation: Mon nay chua duoc nau chin ky

phrases.vietnamese: Cái này có vị hư hỏng
phrases.pronunciation: Cai nay co vi hu hong

phrases.vietnamese: Có thứ gì đó trong thức ăn của tôi
phrases.english: There is something in my food
phrases.pronunciation: Co thu gi do trong thuc an cua toi

phrases.vietnamese: Tôi yêu cầu món này không cay.
phrases.english: I asked for this not spicy.
phrases.pronunciation: Toi yeu cau mon nay khong cay

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Spicy can be personal. The phrase says the dish is too spicy for you, not that the kitchen made a mistake.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Change-this and related food-problem cards keep the request practical if staff offer a fix.

phrases.vietnamese: Bạn có thể thay đổi điều này?
phrases.pronunciation: Ban co the thay doi dieu nay

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: For undercooked, cold, or spoiled dishes, use the nearby food-problem follow-ups without blaming the kitchen.
